articles.title: Daily Spotlight: Min Vol: More than a Defensive Strategy
articles.mainIdea: Daily Spotlight: Min Vol: More than a Defensive Strategy
articles.summary: Argus Research: Daily Spotlight: Min Vol: More than a Defensive Strategy. Uncertainty over President Trump's new tariff policies almost knocked stocks into a bear market a year ago. While growth strategies suffered the most, value strategies also declined. Even bond prices were lower amid the confusion. Stocks have since recovered and the bull market that began in 2022 remains intact. But inflation remains an issue and now the Federal Reserve's treasured and valuable independence may be in question. Is a correction in the offing, given the high level of stock prices? Taking into account all of the variables, is it time for investors to cash in their chips? As the consensus market outlook fluctuates between bullish and bearish, we note that investors exit equities at their own peril. That's because long-term returns from stocks consistently have outpaced long-term returns from other asset classes, such as fixed income and cash, and during times when rates are high or low, or when there is global growth or global recessions. So what's a potential equity strategy for investors amid all the uncertainty? Argus believes that Min Vol is an all-weather strategy that is timely in any investing climate. Academic literature and, more to the point, returns history indicate that Min Vol can deliver market-matching returns on an absolute basis and superior returns on a risk-adjusted basis over various time periods. Argus has developed a sophisticated approach to Min Vol investing, one that is built around our proprietary quality & safety screens. We recently updated our Min-Vol theme model portfolio.
